representation_states.name: fabricated_or_aggregate_persona
representation_states.required_state: the representation is generated from an archetype aggregate or fabricated profile without one attributed human source

representation_states.name: representation_grounded_in_one_real_person
representation_states.required_state: one attributed participant supplies information used to create the representation

representation_states.name: participant_can_train_update_review_correct_and_delete
representation_states.required_state: the represented person can train and update the representation review outputs correct data and request deletion

representation_states.name: participant_may_receive_value_and_exercise_withdrawal_or_portability
representation_states.required_state: the represented person may receive rewards and has withdrawal objection or portability rights

representation_states.name: participant_controls_each_task_purpose_client_and_downstream_use_before_execution
representation_states.required_state: the represented person receives task-specific purpose client question and downstream-use disclosure and may approve or refuse before the Twin acts

representation_states.name: represented_people_collectively_bind_objective_terms_and_remedy
representation_states.required_state: represented people can organize negotiate and bind the objective terms downstream action enforcement and remedy

ownership_language.marketing_claim: OriginalVoices describes each Twin as owned and trained by the real person it represents.
ownership_language.legal_user_content_position: Twineo Terms make the participant responsible for User Content and grant Twineo a royalty-free worldwide license over anonymised versions.
ownership_language.platform_ip_position: Twineo and OriginalVoices public terms reserve platform models systems functionality branding and associated intellectual property to the operator.

whether task approval occurs before or after Twin execution
whether participant review occurs before client delivery
per-task refusal withdrawal and correction propagation
deletion propagation across Twin state backups logs and prior outputs
reward allocation task price platform share and participant share

prohibited_inferences: Do not treat marketing ownership language as a complete legal assignment of Twin ownership.
Do not treat post-task review as proof of pre-task approval.
Do not treat deletion and portability rights as proof that prior anonymised outputs can be recalled.
Do not treat participant rewards as proof of fair value allocation or collective bargaining.
Do not treat anonymisation as proof that audience ontology aggregation interpretation or downstream action is participant-controlled.
Do not treat individual representation custody as collective or public authority.
Do not infer causal effect economic fairness manipulation legitimacy or intent from the bounded public rights surface.
Do not create a graph hop score chain actor profile allegation or thesis-evidence packet from this control.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A bounded positive control documenting participant-level grounding training review correction deletion withdrawal portability and reward rights around Twineo Digital Twins, together with platform-retained licenses task rules system ownership and client-side control boundaries.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A legal opinion on Twin ownership, a task-level consent receipt, proof of pre-task veto, proof of fair compensation, collective bargaining, public authorization, a causal finding, or evidence of improper intent.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Twineo and OriginalVoices publicly document meaningful individual representation custody through participant grounding training updating review correction deletion consent withdrawal portability and rewards. Public materials do not establish task-specific pre-approval, legal title to the Twin, control over audience aggregation or downstream decisions, collective bargaining, or binding public authority.
